scripts.dev: concurrently -n convex,web -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:convex" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.test: (cd apps/web && bunx vitest --config vitest.config.ts) && (cd convex && bunx vitest --config vitest.config.ts)
scripts.test:once: (cd apps/web && bunx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts) && (cd convex && bunx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts)
scripts.type-check: bunx tsc --project convex/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --project packages/plugin-ttg/tsconfig.json
scripts.hygiene: bun run format && bun run lint:fix && bun run type-check
scripts.hygiene:check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run type-check
